{{Quote|All ships of the Coruscant Third Fleet, this is Admiral Peto Kelsan. You will set the self-destruct devices on your ships and then take the lifepods to Ralltiir. ''Avenger'' will cover. ''Good luck''.|Peto Kelsan|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 36">[[Legacy (2006) 36|''Legacy'' (2006) 36]]</ref>}}
'''''Avenger''''' was a [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]] in the service of the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].

==History==
In [[137 ABY]] ''Avenger'' was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Furske]] and served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Coruscant Third Fleet]] commander [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Peto Kelsan]]. ''Avenger'', along with the rest of the fleet was tasked with protecting the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], when the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] and the [[Empire-in-exile]] launched a surprise [[Battle of Ralltiir (Second Imperial Civil War)|attack]] on the planet, intending to seize as many Imperial ships as possible.

When [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Peto Kelsan]] realized that his forces were overwhelmed, he agreed to Admiral [[Edouard Fenel]]'s ultimatum and ordered the fleet to surrender. However, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vaclen Tor]] of the [[Ardent-class fast frigate|''Ardent''-class fast frigate]] [[Steadfast (Ardent-class)|''Steadfast'']] persuaded him to change his mind and stick to his duty. After that Kelsan ordered his men to set their ships for self-destruct and then leave them in the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]. Peto Kelsan himself choose to stay aboard the ''Avenger'' when the ship perished along with rest of the fleet.
